refnamediv.refpurpose: Retrieve a variable from the request

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
name
The variable name.
default
The value to return if the variable is not found.
&reftitle.returnvalues; The value if found, or default if it was provided, &null; otherwise.
